decisions.reason: The source also changes the Small Block prize, and that effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The About-page prize copy is necessarily updated and the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY with the new Small and Big Block values.
The FAQ prize explanation is necessarily updated and the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY reflecting both revised prize schedules.
The Mission-page prize-pool copy is necessarily updated and the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY with the revised schedules.
Changing prize counts and draw cadence does not alter the no-referral trigger, recipient selection, or reward components.
The ticket rules remain expressed relative to each applicable draw; the revised draw cadence does not change issuance, counters, eligibility windows, or reset actions.
The source does not change the flat royalty, founder share, ticket behavior on secondary sales, or the royalty's prize-pool destinations.
The revised prize schedule does not change mint price, founder allocation, referral commission, residual-allocation rule, or prize-pool destinations.
The number and cadence of prizes change, but random ticket-weighted selection through Chainlink VRF and the existing eligibility rules remain unchanged.
Message 158 does not remove or modify Aave yield generation; any conclusion that the integration is redundant requires the later client statement and cannot be propagated from this source event.
The source changes prize amounts, winner counts, and cadence but does not resolve or modify the manual-versus-automatic collection flow.
The prize-schedule change does not affect the fiat provider, conversion path, supported payment methods, or wallet requirement.
